InitiatingParty.name: Initiating Party
InitiatingParty.definition: Details related to the party that initiated the report.

UndertakingIdentification.name: Undertaking Identification
UndertakingIdentification.definition: Details related to the identification of the undertaking.

AmendmentSequenceNumber.name: Amendment Sequence Number
AmendmentSequenceNumber.definition: Sequence number assigned by the issuer to each amendment of the undertaking.

AdvisingPartyReferenceNumber.name: Advising Party Reference Number
AdvisingPartyReferenceNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the advising party to the undertaking.

ConfirmerReferenceNumber.name: Confirmer Reference Number
ConfirmerReferenceNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the confirmer to the undertaking.

StatusCategory.name: Status Category
StatusCategory.definition: Specifies the category of the status.

StatusReason.name: Status Reason
StatusReason.definition: Set of elements used to provide detailed information on the status reason.

OriginalMessageDetails.name: Original Message Details
OriginalMessageDetails.definition: Information concerning the original message to which the status report may be sent in response.

EnclosedFile.name: Enclosed File
EnclosedFile.definition: Document or template enclosed in the report.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information related to the report.
